en.headline: Hong Kong triathlon mixed relay takes Asian Games bronze
en.dek: Cade Wright, Oscar Coggins, Bailee Brown and Robin Elg finished in 1 hour 27 minutes 25 seconds for a third straight Games medal in the event.
body: Hong Kong won bronze in the mixed triathlon relay at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday morning, extending a run of podiums in the event across three consecutive Games.

The team of Cade Wright, Oscar Coggins, Bailee Brown and Robin Elg started at 8.30am Hong Kong time. Wright opened the first leg and finished it in fifth place in 23 minutes 18 seconds. Coggins then posted the fastest bike and run splits of that exchange and lifted Hong Kong to third.

Brown held third through the third leg. Elg dropped to fourth in the swim on the anchor leg before recovering on the bike and run to finish in 1 hour 27 minutes 25 seconds. China took gold in 1:25:54 and Japan silver in 1:26:45.

Coggins, Elg and Brown had all raced the individual events a day earlier. Wright started in place of her twin sister Tallulah Wright, who had contested the women's individual race on Sunday. Under the Jockey Club outstanding athlete award scheme, the four athletes share a HK$500,000 incentive for the bronze.

zh.headline: 港隊鐵人三項混合接力再奪亞運銅牌
zh.dek: 韋祺、奧斯卡、彭詩雅及羅競賓以1小時27分25秒完成，連續三屆亞運在此項目登上頒獎台。
body: 香港鐵人三項隊周一早上在愛知—名古屋亞運會混合接力奪得銅牌，連續三屆亞運在此項目登上頒獎台。
陣容為韋祺、奧斯卡、彭詩雅及羅競賓，賽事香港時間早上8時半起步。韋祺首棒以23分18秒列第五交接；奧斯卡隨後在單車及跑步都錄得該棒最快分段，將港隊帶回第三。
彭詩雅第三棒守住第三。最後一棒羅競賓泳段一度跌至第四，其後在單車及跑步追回，總成績1小時27分25秒。金牌由中國隊以1小時25分54秒奪得，日本隊1小時26分45秒獲銀牌。
奧斯卡、羅競賓及彭詩雅週日剛比完個人賽。韋祺頂替孺生妹妹韋禓出戰首棒，韋禓前一日出戰女子個人賽。四人按賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃可獲合共50萬元獎金。
